question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

To abandon your friends now would be a **break of confidence**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Breach of faith"** means a violation of trust or confidence. (विश्वासघात)

 
 
• **Example:** Sharing someone's secrets without their permission is a** breach of faith.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In the dark** (अंधेरे में): Lacking knowledge or information about something.

 
 
• **Example:** I was completely in the dark about their plans.
 
 
 
• **Spill the beans** (राज़ खोल देना): To reveal secret information unintentionally or indiscreetly.
 
 
• **Example:** She spilled the beans about the surprise party.
 
 
 
• **Off on the wrong foot** (गलत शुरुआत करना): To start something in a negative or problematic way.
 
 
• **Example:** They got off on the wrong foot during their first meeting.
 
 

2f:Tb58,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
